summary: Nora now reliably finds a real playlist when asked to play one, instead of settling for a single video titled "playlist".
details: Asked to play a genre or "a kpop playlist", Nora previously sometimes queued a single multi-hour compilation video whose title claimed to be a playlist -- technically correct (a plain video URL always queues as one track) but not what was asked for.

play_music's guidance now spells out that only an actual YouTube playlist URL (youtube.com/playlist?list=...) queues multiple tracks, and nudges the search itself toward finding one rather than trusting a video's title.
